title: It Followed Me Home
hook: I played every horror game on Pulsebox... now my house is doing the same things

messages.text: 3:07 AM. Jay had spent the whole night on his computer, playing every horror game on Pulsebox. Alone.
i just played ALL the horror games on pulsebox 💀
all 9?? by yourself??
bro i MADE them and even i don't play them alone
yeah well now i'm *super* scared
every creak in this house sounds like the hollow
lol it's just a game. go to sleep
The hallway light flickers.
milo. the hallway light just flickered *3 times*
like the rule in night shift?? 💀
when the lights flicker 3 times you lock the door
the doors ARE locked. ok i'm gonna go check
So he turned on his flashlight... and stepped out into the hallway.
why is the basement door open
you never leave it open
*i never leave it open*
In the kitchen, every cabinet was open. And the fridge was humming in the dark.
there's a note on the fridge
it says *NEVER PLAY ALONE*
jay that's from the game. not funny
i didn't write it
Then, from the bottom of the basement stairs... someone whispered his name.
someone just said my name
it sounded like my *mom*
my mom's on a work trip
DON'T ANSWER IT
in one more night the thing at the door uses a voice you know
Then came three slow knocks. On the front door.
jay it's me. i'm outside
let me in
you live 20 minutes away
*let me in jay*
Missed voice call
jay i just turned my phone on
who have you been texting all night??
Jay ran back to his room. The game was still open on his computer. And someone was standing in his doorway.
Nine horror games, free on Pulsebox. box.pulseform.org. It's a computer game site, so it only works on a computer. Play if you dare... but never play alone.
